Development scenes may be in RawNIND training. Test targets must stay out of model selection.

selection.notes: GFX100S / 55mm. Noisy DSCF3879: ISO6400, f/1.7, 1/240s, 17:13:27. Reference DSCF3880: ISO100, f/5.6, 3s, 17:17:05. Captured 3m38s apart with nearly identical framing. Aperture, depth of field, clouds, lights and moving subjects still differ. Native sensor crops with input/reference-only integer coordinate matching; no resizing or warping, no per-panel brightness adjustment. Qualitative reference, not exact ground truth; evaluation-only, never training.

decision: Stop V50 at1000; known-primary and photo PSNR regress with negative source intervals; no decisive native visual gain. More data/convergence generally remain unproven. Keep V43 reference and preserve the extension for future experiments.

training_plan.purpose: Data-only model trial, rank0/original full resolution and precision; wait for completed reviewed4x cache/hash freeze. Existing eval identities unchanged.

visual_review: Fine fabric remains smoothed; building/sky close, GFX leaves and fence soft, irregular/colored wire intersections remain.
